[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.26] (2) A Protocol offer must—

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.26] (a) be set out in the Court Proceedings Pack (Part B) Form; and

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.26] (b) contain the final total amount of the offers from both parties. ## Time when a Protocol offer is made

## 36.27

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.27] (1) The Protocol offer is deemed to be made on the first business day after the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form is sent to the defendant. [PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.27] (2) In this Section “business day” has the same meaning as in rule 6.2. ## General provisions

## 36.28 A Protocol offer—

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.28 A Protocol offer—] (a) is treated as exclusive of all interest; and

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.28 A Protocol offer—] (b) has the consequences set out in this Section only in relation to the fixed costs of the Stage 3 Procedure as provided for in rule 45.18, and not in relation to the costs of any appeal from the final decision of those proceedings. ## Restrictions on the disclosure of a Protocol offer

## 36.29

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.29] (1) The amount of the Protocol offer must not be communicated to the court until the claim is determined. [PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.29] (2) Any other offer to settle must not be communicated to the court at all. ## Costs consequences following judgment

## 36.30

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (1) This rule applies where, on any determination by the court, the claimant obtains judgment against the defendant for an amount of damages that is—

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (a) less than or equal to the amount of the defendant’s Protocol offer;

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (b) more than the defendant’s Protocol offer but less than the claimant’s Protocol offer; or

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (c) equal to or more than the claimant’s Protocol offer. [PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (2) Where paragraph (1)(a) applies, the court must order the claimant to pay—

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (a) the fixed costs in rule 45.37; and

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (b) interest on those fixed costs from the first business day after the deemed date of the Protocol offer under rule 36.27. [PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (3) Where paragraph (1)(b) applies, the court must order the defendant to pay the fixed costs in rule 45.30. [PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (4) Where paragraph (1)(c) applies, the court must order the defendant to pay—

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (a) interest on the whole of the damages awarded at a rate not exceeding 10% above base rate for some or all of the period starting with the date specified in rule 36.27;

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (b) the fixed costs in rule 45.30;

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (c) interest on those fixed costs at a rate not exceeding 10% above base rate; and

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > 36.30] (d) an additional amount calculated in accordance with rule 36.17(4)(d). ## Deduction of benefits

[PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > Deduction of benefits] 36.31 For the purposes of rule 36.30(1)(a) the amount of the judgment is less than the Protocol offer where the judgment is less than that offer once deductible amounts identified in the judgment are deducted. [PART 36 – OFFERS TO SETTLE > Deduction of benefits] (“Deductible amount” is defined in rule 36.20(1)(d).)
